AXIS M5000 PTZ Camera
Situational awareness camera with build-in PTZ
AXIS M5000 PTZ features three 5 MP sensors and one PTZ camera with 10x optical zoom for total situational awareness
of indoor areas up to 400 m2 (4300 ft2). With everything displayed on one monitor, you can move from overview to
detailed views in a single click. It features autofocus capabilities and day/night functionality. This cost-effective camera
offers the benefits of four cameras while installing just one camera. Furthermore, edge storage lets you record directly
to anonboardmemory card.
> 3x 5 MP sensors for situational awareness
> Total overview, zoomed-in details
> Covers indoor areas up to 400 m2 (4300 ft2)
> 10x optical zoom with HDTV 1080p
> Autofocus
